# strinsert

Inserts a string. *(version 4.67 or later)*

## Format

```ttl
strinsert <strvar> <index> <string>
```

## Remarks

Inserts a specified instance of &lt;string&gt; at a specified &lt;index&gt; position(1-origin) in the string variable &lt;strvar&gt;.

## Example

```ttl
s='abc'
strinsert s 3 'XYZ'  ; 'abXYZc'
messagebox s s

s='abc'
strinsert s 1 'XYZ'  ; 'XYZabc'
messagebox s s

s='abc'
strinsert s -1 'XYZ'  ; Syntax error
messagebox s s

s='abc'
strinsert s 0 'XYZ'  ; Syntax error
messagebox s s

s='abc'
strinsert s 4 'XYZ'  ; 'abcXYZ'
messagebox s s

s='abc'
strinsert s 5 'XYZ'  ; Syntax error
messagebox s s
```
